question: By what means does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to be known or to have become known in this context.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the one addressed.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: It is by the grace of the lord of the Kaulas that the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact sense of jñāta here cannot be fixed from this verse alone.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
